title: Quantification of SARS-CoV-2 Using Membrane Filtration and dPCR
author: Solana Narum
materials: QIAgen AllPrep PowerViral DNA/RNA Extraction Kit
Adjust the pH to 3.5 using Hydrochloric acid Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) , mixing the sample between titrations.

Submerge two forceps in 70% ethanol and sterilize using a lit flame. While leaving the vacuum on to hold the filter in place, use both forceps to gently roll the filter tightly enough to fit inside a 2 mL tube. Place the rolled filter into a Glass Bead tube, a consumable included in the Qiagen AllPrep PowerViral DNA/RNA Extraction Kit Qiagen Catalog #28000-50 .

Warm PM1 from the Qiagen AllPrep PowerViral DNA/RNA Extraction Kit Qiagen Catalog #28000-50 at 55 °C for 5-10 minutes before use. Add 6 µL 2-mercaptoethanol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #M6250 and 600 µL PM1 to the Glass Bead tube. Also add these reagents to an empty Glass Bead with 500 µL of Zymo DNA/RNA Shield Fisher Scientific Catalog #50-125-1706 to serve as the extraction control.
Thaw GT-Molecular controls and assay solutions on ice. If necessary, also thaw the extracted RNA on ice. Once thawed, vortex to mix.
In the dPCR Parameters section under the Priming tab, select the Qiagen Standard Priming Profile.
To each tube add 6 µL 2-mercaptoethanol and 600 µL PM1 from the Qiagen AllPrep PowerViral DNA/RNA Kit and invert to mix.

steps.title: Prepare BCoV Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the Bovilis Coronavirus (BCoV) internal process control (Merck Animal Health Catalog #16445).

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized virus in 5 mL pre-chilled molecular grade water; swirl to mix.
Aliquot 100 µL stock into sterile 1.5 mL tubes, label as BCoV ND (non-diluted), and store at -80 °C.
Dilute 60 µL BCoV ND with 540 µL pre-chilled molecular grade water and pipette to mix; label as BCoV INT (intermediate).
Dilute 500 µL BCoV INT with 49.5 mL pre-chilled molecular grade water and invert to mix.
Aliquot 1 mL of BCoV working into sterile 1.5 mL tubes and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Storage
steps.instruction: Collect composite primary influent samples over 24 hours (several samples per hour).

substeps.instruction: Collect 100 mL sub-samples into 2 x 50 mL sterile conical tubes.
Store samples at 4 °C until processing.

steps.title: Sample Spiking and Filtration
steps.instruction: Perform these steps in a Class II Biosafety Cabinet cleaned with RNase Away and water.

substeps.instruction: Thaw an aliquot of BCoV working on ice (do not vortex).
Add 62 µL of BCoV working to each 50 mL wastewater sample and invert to mix.
Setup filtration apparatus by attaching tubing to the vacuum port of the vacuum flask and vacuum pump, placing a microfunnel on the flask stopper.
Transfer 25 mL of wastewater sample into the microfunnel using a 25 mL serological pipette and turn on the vacuum pump.
Once the sample has passed through, remove the upper section of the microfunnel, leaving the filter on the lower portion.

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using the QIAcube system, maintaining aseptic technique and using cold blocks to prevent degradation.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 1x Zymo DNA/RNA Shield (Fisher Scientific Catalog #50-125-1706) to the Glass Bead tube and vortex to mix.
Place Glass Bead tubes in a FastPrep-24 Instrument and run 4 cycles of 20 seconds each at 4.5 m/s (ensure spoke plate is rotated to hold lids down).
Centrifuge Glass Bead tubes for 1 minute at 16,000 x g.
Place spin columns and elution tubes in the Qiagen QIAcube rotor adapter and transfer the supernatant from the Glass Bead tubes into the center tube.
Place adapters in the QIAcube centrifuge and follow tablet instructions to set up shaker rack, reagents, and tips.
Shake to mix PM5 buffer and set elution volume to 100 µL; start the extraction run.
Cap elution tubes upon completion and either begin dPCR or store at -80 °C.
Discard used pipette tips and wipe the waste drawer and QIAcube workspace with 70% ethanol.
Remove plastic tube holder and reagent tray, then run 2 cycles of UV decontamination.

steps.title: dPCR Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare RNA samples and master mixes for PMMoV and N1-N2-BCoV assays.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL extracted RNA with 99 µL RNase-free water for PMMoV analysis.

Prepare master mixes for PMMoV and N1-N2-BCoV assays (using GT-Digital SARS-CoV-2 Wastewater Surveillance Assay and Qiagen QIAcuity One-Step Viral RT-PCR Kit Catalog #1123145), including one extra sample; vortex to mix.
Pipette 20 µL of the appropriate master mix (N1-N2-BCoV or PMMoV) into PCR strip tube wells.
Add 20 µL of extracted RNA sample (use 1:100 dilution for PMMoV) or positive control to the PCR strip tube; pipette gently to mix and keep on ice.
For non-template control (NTC), pipette 20 µL of molecular grade water instead of RNA.

steps.title: dPCR Plate Loading and Setup
steps.instruction: Transfer samples to the QIAcuity Nanoplate and configure the instrument.

substeps.instruction: Place a Qiagen QIAcuity 26k 24-well Nanoplate onto the protection tray (wipe tray with 70% ethanol if dusty).
Using a multichannel pipette, transfer 39 µL of solution from PCR strips to the Nanoplate, avoiding air bubbles and not pushing the pipette beyond the first stop.
Seal the Nanoplate with a Nanoplate seal and the provided roller.
Place the sealed plate in the QIAcuity instrument drawer.
On the tablet, select 'New Plate', name it, and choose 'Nanoplate 26k 24-well'.
Configure Cycling and Imaging tabs according to GT Molecular Wastewater Surveillance Guide recommendations.
In 'Reaction mixes', create 'N1-N2-BCoV Triplex Assay' and 'PMMoV Assay'.
In 'Samples and controls', add sample names, extraction controls, positive controls (N1-N2-BCoV and PMMoV), and NTCs (N1-N2-BCoV dPCRNeg and PMMoV dPCRNeg).
In 'Plate Layout', assign reaction mixes, samples, and controls to wells; save and exit.

steps.title: dPCR Run and Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Execute the dPCR run and export the quantified results.

substeps.instruction: Select the plate on the QIAcuity tablet and run the reaction.
Ensure image transfer is complete in the Software Suite before inspecting data.
Select 'Analysis', select all wells and targets, and select 'Show results'.
In the 1D Scatterplot tab, verify and adjust the automatic threshold between negative and positive partitions if necessary.
Export data to CSV using the 'Export to CSV' button in the List tab.

steps.title: BCoV Working Concentration Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the BCoV spike to determine the working concentration.

substeps.instruction: Extract an aliquot of BCoV working in triplicate: add 100 µL of BCoV working into three 1.5 mL tubes.
Microcentrifuge tubes at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Add supernatant to the center column of a rotor adapter and process via QIAcube extraction.
Analyze the extraction triplicates using the dPCR steps described above.
Calculate BCoV working concentration using the average measured concentration in copies/µL of the 3 replicates.
